state_model.pending: approved and registered, not yet in implementation
state_model.spec_ready: sdd feature with complete approved spec, ready to implement
state_model.in_progress: the single feature currently being implemented

state_invariants: at most one feature may be in_progress at any time
features with sdd=true must pass through spec_ready before implementation
blocked is metadata and does not replace the main status
reopening returns a feature to pending and records the reopen reason
done requires the validation required by project rules
